summary: The failure test is an alias for failed: true when a registered result has failed set, not for skipped or never-run tasks.
questions: Is failure the same as failed test?
How do I check task failure with the failure test?

answer_card.title: failure test
answer_card.answer_md: `result is failure` is an alias of `failed`: true when `failed: true`. Skipped or never-executed tasks don't count.
